name: SKY Perfect JSAT Holdings Inc.
summary: SKY Perfect JSAT Holdings Inc., previously known as SKY Perfect JSAT Corp, is a Japanese enterprise that specializes in delivering broadcasting and telecommunication services. Its diverse offerings encompass mobile satellite communication, pay-per-view television channels, and high-definition broadcasting. The company is structured into two main operational segments: the Multichannel Pay TV Business and the Space and Satellite Business. The Multichannel Pay TV division provides comprehensive platform services, including customer management for broadcasting companies, while also delivering broadcast content. The Space and Satellite Business, on the other hand, supplies communication satellite infrastructure to broadcasters and offers a range of satellite communication services, such as data and mobile connectivity, to governmental bodies, public sector organizations, and corporate clients.
